events.name: Ludlow Food Festival – Friday daytime
events.description: Friday daytime session of the 2026 Ludlow Food Festival, with independent food and drink producers, talks, demos, live fire cooking, trails and kids' activities.

events.name: Ludlow Food Festival – Friday evening
events.description: Friday evening session of Ludlow Food Festival, running 6:30pm–10pm local time.

events.name: Shropshire Oktoberfest – Friday
events.description: Friday session of Shropshire Oktoberfest with independent beers, ciders and spirits, street food, live music and entertainment. Event is primarily adult-focused.
events.parking_transport: Shrewsbury bus station is about a 10-minute walk; Shrewsbury railway station about a 15-minute walk.

events.name: Shropshire Oktoberfest – Saturday
events.description: Saturday session of Shropshire Oktoberfest with local drinks producers, street food, live music, comedy, silent disco and Carpool Karaoke.
events.parking_transport: Shrewsbury bus station is about a 10-minute walk; Shrewsbury railway station about a 15-minute walk.

events.name: Market Drayton Oktoberfest
events.description: Unticketed Oktoberfest across participating Market Drayton pubs with German beer, food and entertainment. Food and drink purchased separately.

events.description: Illuminated North Pole-themed festive trail through Chelsea & Maxell Gardens.
